day_shape: 70 items dominated by Strait of Hormuz dispute (Trump rejecting Iran reopening proposal, Qalibaf claiming $35-50 oil premium), IDF killing two Oct 7 hostage-holders in Gaza, Hezbollah drone-strike exchange in south Lebanon, and heavy Khamenei/IRIB messaging cycle; nothing from UK Parliament, State Dept or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz standoff and oil flows
threads.summary: Iran International reported Hormuz oil flows have risen despite Iranian threats to shipping, while a Jerusalem Post analysis said Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the strait. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf claimed on IRIB and Defa Press that oil carries a $35-50 premium over pre-war levels, and IRIB posted an item asking when Iran should enforce its Hormuz 'security system.'

threads.label: Iranian officials on talks and confrontation
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi told IRIB Iran is ready both for negotiations and to confront aggression 'even if it leads to a destructive war,' and dismissed US midterm elections as irrelevant. Army spokesperson Akraminia told the Jerusalem Post the US could launch a renewed attack, and Central Bank Governor Hemmati pushed back on US Treasury Secretary claims of successful economic pressure.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Oct 7 hostage-holders in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced Hamas commander Muhammad Ghabain, involved in holding nine named hostages including Alon Ohel and Keith Siegel, was killed in a Tuesday strike in northern Gaza. Separately, Saher Nidal Saqr, who drove the motorcycle used to abduct Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or, was killed by the Israel Police Gideonim Unit in Nuseirat.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone and IDF retaliation
threads.summary: Hezbollah launched an explosive drone at IDF troops in the southern Lebanon buffer zone overnight, causing no injuries, according to the IDF. In response, Israeli forces struck several Hezbollah infrastructure sites including drone and anti-tank missile launch positions.

threads.label: Gaza operations, civilian-shield footage and NGO claims
threads.summary: The IDF released drone footage it says shows a Hamas operative using a child to move weapons into a civilian home in central Gaza, saying troops refrained from striking. The Ground Forces chief extended a ban on small attack drones after last week's fatal FPV 'Atalef' accident, and ToI questioned journalistic flaws in the NAZA documentary alleging IDF misconduct.

threads.label: Israeli navy, Qatar and post-war politics
threads.summary: Senior navy officers told the Jerusalem Post the new INS Drakon submarine has entered service with expanded range for operations near Iran and Yemen. Qatar's prime minister accused Netanyahu of blocking the US-backed Gaza peace plan, while election challenger Eisenkot described the PM's approval of Qatari funds to Hamas as 'between breach of trust and treason.'

threads.label: Regime messaging cycle and Pezeshkian challenges
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB posted heavy commemorative content including 'unseen' images of the Supreme Leader, a funeral procession for Commander Zarifi in Mashhad, and IRGC images of a second captured US underwater drone. Iran International reported families of protesters killed in January's crackdown publicly challenged Pezeshkian's UN characterisation of the unrest as foreign-driven.

events.title_en: 26 attacks by Saudi aggressor fighter jets on Yemen in the past 24 hours
events.summary_en: 26 attacks by Saudi aggressor fighter jets on Yemen in the past 24 hours. Brigadier Yahya Saree, spokesman for Yemen's armed forces, stated that these attacks were carried out with F-15 fighter jets from Khamis Mushayt airbase. Saudi aggressor fighter jets in these attacks bombed Taiz, Jawf, Marib, Dhamar and Saada provinces, resulting in the deaths and injuries of dozens of civilians. The total number of Saudi aggressions since the beginning of escalation of tensions against Yemen has reached 1085 air and missile attacks. Yemen's armed forces, in a lightning operation and in less than two weeks, managed to advance in the south and coastal areas and liberate areas overlooking the strategic Strait of Bab al-Mandab.

For those who believe what America says, we have left a free dollar-printing machine at the Strait of Hormuz; come and get it!

The strike in central Gaza's Nuseirat targeted Saher Nidal Saqr, who the IDF says was affiliated with "global jihadist organisations," and invaded Israel on October 7, 2023.

Infamous footage from the Hamas -led onslaught showed Saqr taking Argamani on a motorcycle to the Strip, after she and Or were abducted from the Nova music festival.

events.title: Hezbollah launched an explosive drone at Israeli troops operating in southern Lebanon overnight, the military says, prompting strikes on the terror group's sites in response. The IDF says no injuries were caused by the drone that targeted troops in the south Lebanon buffer zone. Several Hezbollah infrastructure sites in southern Lebanon were struck in response, including drone and anti-tank missile launching posts, the military says.
